activities.description: Children arrange pillows on the floor and create a path to jump, crawl, or step over. They take turns going through the course and adding new obstacles.

activities.title: Snack Preparation Together
activities.description: Siblings prepare a simple snack together—one spreads while the other arranges on a plate. They share tasks and decide portions.

activities.title: Toy Delivery Service
activities.description: One child requests toys and the other retrieves and delivers them. They practice communication and cooperation through this back-and-forth exchange.

activities.title: Diaper Changing Helper
activities.description: The older sibling assists during the baby's diaper change by handing wipes or holding a toy. The older child participates in caring for the younger one.

activities.title: Water Cup Transfer
activities.description: The child pours water from one cup to another using small containers. The child practices pouring without spilling.

activities.title: Spoon and Bowl Practice
activities.description: The child scoops dry beans or rice from one bowl to another using a spoon. The child works on grip and coordination.
activities.things_needed: Two bowls, spoon, dry beans or rice

activities.title: Shoe Lineup
activities.description: The child gathers all household shoes and lines them up by the door. The child may sort by size, color, or owner.

activities.title: Drawer Opening Exploration
activities.description: The child opens and closes safe drawers in the kitchen, feeling the weight and resistance. The child may remove and replace safe items.

activities.title: Mud Pie Kitchen
activities.description: The child mixes dirt and water in containers to create mud pies. The child uses hands, spoons, or sticks to shape and mold the mud.

activities.title: Spray Bottle Water Art
activities.description: The child sprays water from a bottle onto the sidewalk or fence to create wet patterns. The child watches the water spread and evaporate.

activities.title: Puddle Stomping
activities.description: The child jumps and stomps in puddles, observing splashes and ripples. The child may use hands to touch the water.

activities.title: Shaving Cream Exploration
activities.description: The child spreads shaving cream on a tray or table and explores the texture with hands. The child may draw designs or hide small objects in the foam.
activities.activity_safety_concerns: Supervise to prevent ingestion

activities.title: Yogurt Finger Painting
activities.description: The child spreads yogurt on a high chair tray and creates patterns with fingers. The child may taste the yogurt while exploring.

activities.title: Corn Starch and Water Goo
activities.description: The child mixes corn starch with water to create a substance that is solid when squeezed and liquid when released. The child explores this unique texture.

activities.title: Bathtub Color Mixing
activities.description: The child adds a few drops of food coloring to bath water and watches the colors spread and mix. The child may use multiple colors to create new ones.
activities.activity_safety_concerns: May stain skin temporarily

activities.title: Sponge Squeezing and Dripping
activities.description: The child soaks sponges in water and squeezes them over containers or in the bathtub. The child watches water drip and stream from the sponge.

activities.title: Paint with Ice Cubes
activities.description: The child holds ice cubes made from colored water and paints on paper as they melt. The child watches the ice transform into colored streaks.

activities.title: Bubble Bath Play
activities.description: The child creates and pops bubbles in the bathtub, stacking them or moving them around. The child feels the foam texture and watches bubbles disappear.

activities.title: Pasta Dough Play
activities.description: The child explores cooked pasta mixed with a little oil, squishing and pulling the slippery strands. The child may fill and dump containers with pasta.

activities.title: Sticky Contact Paper Collage
activities.description: The child sticks small objects like tissue paper pieces or yarn onto contact paper placed sticky-side-up on a table. The child creates a textured collage.
activities.things_needed: Clear contact paper, small collage materials

activities.title: Flour Cloud
activities.description: The child pats and pours flour in a contained tray, creating clouds of dust. The child may draw in the flour or hide objects beneath it.
activities.activity_safety_concerns: Supervise to prevent inhalation or ingestion

activities.title: Ketchup Squeeze Art
activities.description: The child squeezes ketchup from a bottle onto a plate to create designs and patterns. The child explores controlled squeezing and flowing lines.

activities.title: Wet Sand Molding
activities.description: The child packs wet sand into containers and molds to create shapes. The child may add water to dry sand or build structures that hold together.

activities.title: Oil and Water Separation
activities.description: The child pours oil and water into a clear bottle and shakes it to observe separation. The child watches the liquids divide into layers.

activities.title: Watermelon Smashing
activities.description: The child uses a toy hammer or hands to break apart chunks of watermelon on a tray. The child explores the fruit's texture and juice.

activities.title: Berry Picking and Washing
activities.description: The child picks berries from containers and places them in a colander to rinse under running water. The child watches water flow through the colander.

activities.title: Egg Cracking Practice
activities.description: The child cracks eggs into a bowl, learning to tap and pull apart the shell. The parent may demonstrate first and the child practices with multiple eggs.

activities.title: Peeling Garlic Cloves
activities.description: The child peels papery skins from garlic cloves and places them in a bowl. The child feels the layers and smells the garlic aroma.

activities.title: Washing Vegetables
activities.description: The child scrubs vegetables under running water with a soft brush. They rinse each piece and place it in a clean bowl.
activities.things_needed: Vegetables, soft brush, bowl, access to sink

activities.title: Peeling Bananas
activities.description: The child pulls back the peel of a banana, starting from a small tear made by an adult. They place the peel in a compost bowl and break the banana into pieces.
activities.things_needed: Bananas, small bowl for peels, plate

activities.title: Spreading Butter
activities.description: The child uses a butter knife to spread soft butter onto toast or crackers. They control the pressure and coverage.
activities.things_needed: Soft butter, toast or crackers, butter knife, plate

activities.title: Cracking Eggs
activities.description: The child taps an egg against the bowl edge and pulls the shell apart. They separate any shell pieces that fall in.
activities.things_needed: Eggs, bowl, small dish for shells
activities.activity_safety_concerns: Raw egg handling - handwashing required

activities.title: Juicing Citrus
activities.description: The child presses halved oranges or lemons onto a hand juicer, rotating and applying pressure. They pour the juice into a cup.
activities.things_needed: Citrus fruits (halved), hand juicer, cup, towel

activities.title: Tearing Lettuce
activities.description: The child pulls lettuce leaves into smaller pieces for a salad. They place torn pieces into a serving bowl.
activities.things_needed: Lettuce head, large bowl, damp cloth for wiping hands

activities.title: Grinding Pepper
activities.description: The child turns a pepper mill over a bowl or plate. They observe the ground pepper falling and smell the aroma.
activities.things_needed: Pepper mill, small bowl or plate

activities.title: Whisking Ingredients
activities.description: The child uses a whisk to blend ingredients in a bowl. They maintain a steady circular motion and watch the mixture change.
activities.things_needed: Whisk, bowl, ingredients to mix (eggs, pancake batter, etc.)

activities.title: Scooping Flour
activities.description: The child uses a measuring cup to scoop flour from a container into a bowl. They level each scoop and count aloud.
activities.things_needed: Flour container, measuring cups, bowl, tray to catch spills

activities.title: Rolling Dough
activities.description: The child uses a rolling pin to flatten dough on a clean surface. They apply even pressure and rotate the dough.
activities.things_needed: Dough, rolling pin, clean surface or mat, flour for dusting

activities.title: Arranging Fruit Slices
activities.description: The child places pre-cut fruit slices onto a serving plate in patterns or arrangements. They handle each piece carefully.

activities.title: Shucking Corn
activities.description: The child pulls back the husk and removes silk strands from corn. They place cleaned corn in a bowl.
activities.things_needed: Fresh corn ears, large bowl, trash bowl for husks

activities.title: Grating Cheese
activities.description: The child holds a box grater steady and rubs cheese down the large holes. They watch shreds fall into the bowl below.
activities.things_needed: Box grater, block of cheese, bowl, damp cloth
activities.activity_safety_concerns: Sharp grater - watch fingers

activities.title: Pouring Batter
activities.description: The child pours pancake or muffin batter from a measuring cup into a pan or muffin tin. They control the flow and stop before overflowing.
activities.things_needed: Prepared batter, measuring cup with spout, muffin tin or pan
activities.activity_safety_concerns: Hot stove/oven nearby - parent handles cooking

activities.title: Finger Painting with Pudding
activities.description: The child spreads pudding on a tray or highchair surface with their hands. They make swirls and patterns and taste as they explore.
activities.things_needed: Pudding (chocolate or vanilla), tray or highchair, towels, washcloth

activities.title: Ice Block Excavation
activities.description: The child chips away at a large ice block containing frozen toys using a spoon or small hammer. They observe the ice melting and objects emerging.
activities.things_needed: Large ice block with toys frozen inside, towels, shallow bin, spoon or toy hammer

activities.title: Muddy Car Wash
activities.description: The child covers toy cars in mud then washes them clean in a bin of soapy water. They scrub with a brush and rinse.
activities.things_needed: Toy cars, dirt/mud, bin of soapy water, scrub brush, towel, hose

activities.title: Pouring Water Between Containers
activities.description: The child transfers water from one bath container to another using cups or small pitchers. They practice controlling the stream and minimizing spills.

activities.title: Washing Bath Toys
activities.description: The child scrubs bath toys with a washcloth or soft brush. They rinse each toy and line them up on the tub edge.
activities.things_needed: Bath toys, washcloth or soft brush, mild soap

activities.title: Scooping Floating Objects
activities.description: The child uses a small net or slotted spoon to scoop floating bath toys or foam shapes. They transfer items to a container.
activities.things_needed: Small net or slotted spoon, floating objects, container

activities.title: Bath Foam Art
activities.description: The child shapes bath foam or shaving cream on the tub wall or on a bath-safe surface. They make patterns and smooth it with their hands.
activities.things_needed: Bath foam or child-safe shaving cream

activities.title: Squeezing Water Toys
activities.description: The child fills squeeze toys with water and empties them by squeezing. They observe the water stream and refill repeatedly.

activities.title: Bath Crayons Drawing
activities.description: The child draws on the tub walls or tiles with bath crayons. They rinse their drawings away with water.

activities.title: Color Mixing with Bath Tablets
activities.description: The child drops color-changing bath tablets into water and watches the colors swirl and blend. They observe the water temperature change if using fizzing tablets.

activities.title: Sink and Float Exploration
activities.description: The child tests various bath-safe objects to see which ones sink and which float. They sort items into two groups.
activities.things_needed: Assorted bath-safe objects (plastic toys, sponges, cups, etc.)

activities.title: Water Temperature Sensing
activities.description: The child feels water in different containers at varying temperatures (warm, cool). They describe what they notice and choose their preferred temperature.
activities.things_needed: Multiple containers with water at different safe temperatures
activities.activity_safety_concerns: Test water temperatures - avoid anything too hot

activities.title: Funnel and Tube Play
activities.description: The child pours water through funnels connected to tubes or pipes. They watch the water travel and emerge at the other end.
activities.things_needed: Funnels, plastic tubing or pipes, cups

activities.title: Bath Sponge Squeezing
activities.description: The child soaks sponges in water and squeezes them out. They watch water drip and feel the sponge change from heavy to light.
activities.things_needed: Natural or synthetic sponges of various sizes

activities.title: Waterfall Creation
activities.description: The child stacks containers with holes to create a waterfall effect. They pour water at the top and watch it cascade down.
activities.things_needed: Stacking cups or containers with drainage holes, pitcher

activities.title: Bubble Blowing Practice
activities.description: The child dips a bubble wand in soapy water and blows gently to create bubbles. They observe bubbles floating and popping.
activities.things_needed: Bubble solution, bubble wands or loops

activities.title: Measuring Bath Water
activities.description: The child uses measuring cups to fill the bathtub or containers with specific amounts of water. They count scoops or compare cup sizes.
activities.things_needed: Measuring cups of various sizes, containers

activities.title: Puddle Jumping
activities.description: The child jumps in puddles after rain. They observe the splash patterns and water displacement.

activities.title: Rain Sound Listening
activities.description: The child sits near a window or under shelter and listens to rain falling. They identify different sounds (dripping, pattering, wind).
activities.things_needed: Window or covered outdoor area, comfortable seating

activities.title: Snow Scooping and Pouring
activities.description: The child uses cups and scoops to transfer snow between containers. They observe how snow packs and changes shape.
activities.things_needed: Snow, cups, scoops, containers, warm clothing

activities.title: Wind Chime Observation
activities.description: The child stands near wind chimes and listens to the sounds created by wind. They watch the chimes move and connect movement to sound.

activities.title: Cloud Watching
activities.description: The child lies on their back and watches clouds move across the sky. They point out shapes they recognize.
activities.things_needed: Blanket or mat, partly cloudy day

activities.title: Feeling Temperature Changes
activities.description: The child moves between sunny and shaded areas, noticing temperature differences. They describe how each spot feels on their skin.
activities.things_needed: Outdoor area with sun and shade

activities.title: Collecting Rainwater
activities.description: The child places containers outside during rain to collect water. They check periodically and measure how much has accumulated.

activities.title: Shadow Tracking
activities.description: The child observes their shadow at different times of day. They notice how it changes position and length as the sun moves.
